title: coding-study learn path document
description: `cstudy learn <path> --json`: one learning path, step by step. Spec: docs/specs/cli.md#cstudy-learn

next.description: The first step not done, or null when every step is

id.description: The canonical ID of the guide or the problem, `<kind>/<slug>`

title.description: The slug when the catalog lacks the step

level.description: A problem step's target level: done once it passes; null on a guide and on a problem that is done once it passes

status.description: As `cstudy learn --path` writes it: `read`, `not read`, `passed`, `level 2 passed`, `missing` or the problem's status

level_passed.description: The highest level of a problem step passed; null on a guide and on a problem without levels
